combatBattery.replenishment: Charges persist across encounters and do not refresh at ordinary turn start or combat start; strategic replenishment remains a later logistics rule.
combatBattery.fallback: If the intended +1 TP / 3-charge implementation remains a compulsory TL1 choice, test 2 charges before considering a TL2 entry-floor move.

powerCapacitor.tacticalRule: After discharge the capacitor is empty. On a later turn the ship may spend 1 otherwise available TP to recharge it; the recharged point becomes usable on a subsequent turn.
powerCapacitor.campaignRule: Unlike a Combat Battery, the capacitor is not a finite consumable; between-encounter charging remains abstracted by existing strategic/FTL reset rules pending later strategic-power implementation.

shieldRecharge.rule: Any functional ship may allocate Tactical Power to shield recharge subject to the shield/recharge profile and available power. Combat Battery and Power Capacitor may alter available power but do not unlock recharge.

amm.rule: Finite interceptor ammunition is a multi-combat endurance constraint. Single-fight parity is not required and normal play should not force routine return-to-port reloads after every missile engagement.

magazineExpansions.rule: Kinetic and Missile Magazine Expansions are endurance/logistics choices and require repeated-engagement stress evidence in addition to single-duel results.
